chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab and Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who died and left behind his two parents, he said: 'For the father is two shares, and for the mother is one share.'
ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance shares of parents when a person dies without children?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the inheritance distribution for parents in the absence of descendants, a scenario governed by the principle of 'Radd' (returning the remainder to the heirs). The 2:1 ratio for father to mother is derived from the general rule in Surah An-Nisa, but this specific hadith confirms its application when no children are present, distinguishing it from cases where the father's share might be affected by other heirs like brothers.
